sentences.text:
1. By way of the present petition filed under Articles 14, 16, 21 and 226 of the Constitution of  I n d i a , D e s a i M a h e s a b h a i B a b a r b h a i , p a r t y i n  p e r s o n h a s c h a l l e n g e d t h e o r d e r d a t e d 5 . 1 2 . 2 0 1 3 p a s s e d  b y t h e C o l l e c t o r , M e h s a n a , b y w h i c h t h e C o l l e c t o r , M e h s a n a h a s  r e s t r a i n e d h i m s e l f f r o m f i n a l l y a l l o t t i n g a F a i r P r i c e S h o p , a n d a l s o  challenged the order dated 13.06.2013 passed in Appeal No. 52 of 2012, by which,
 respondent No. 1 has remanded the matter to respondent No. 2.
2.

Brief facts arise from the record are as under:
Pursuant to advertisement, several persons applied for establishment of a  f a i r p r i c e s h o p . T h e p e t i t i o n e r w a s f o u n d  eligible for getting license for establishing the fair price shop and accordingly the  C o l l e c t o r p a s s e d t h e o r d e r o n 2 1 .
T h e  order passed by the Collector was challenged before the Appellate  Desai Maheshbhai Babarbhai vs State Of Gujarat & 3 on 3 February, 2014 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147711841/

sentences.text: 1 Authority by way of appeal No. 52 of 2012 by private respondent.

The Appellate Authority - respondent No. 1, after considering the facts and  c i r c u m s t a n c e s o f t h e c a s e , r e m a n d e d t h e c a s e t o t h e  Collector for deciding it afresh after giving an opportunity to the  petitioner and all concerned of being heard.
Pursuant to the said  order, the Collector passed the impugned order dated 5.12.2013.
hence this petition.

3. Pursuant to issuance of notice issued by this Court, private respondent has filed  a f f i d a v i t i n r e p l y a n d s u b m i t t e d t h a t t h e p e t i t i o n i s a t p r e  mature stage and be rejected at this stage..

4. Partyinperson, who is present in the Court, has submitted that the Appellate Authority  o u g h t t o h a v e g i v e n a n o p p o r t u n i t y t o  r e m o v e t h e o b j e c t i o n s , w h i c h h a v e b e e n r a i s e d b y t h e a u t h o r i t y  and would not remand the case to the Collector, and therefore, the petition be allowed.
5 . M r . R a k e s h P a t e l , l e a r n e d A G P a p p e a r i n g f o r r e s p o n d e n t N o .

1  submitted that the Collector has not finally decided the matter, however, restrained himself  f r o m p a s s i n g a n y o r d e r s i n c e t h e  C e n t r a l G o v e r n m e n t h a s e n a c t e d t h e F o o d S a f e t y a n d S t a n d a r d s  A c t , 2 0 0 6 .
C o n s i d e r i n g t h e p r o v i s i o n s o f s u c h a c t , t h e a u t h o r i t y
s h a l l i s s u e a p p r o p r i a t e p o l i c y a n d t h e r e f o r e , t h e C o l l e c t o r h i m s e l f
has restrained from passing any order.
6 . I h a v e h e a r d p a r t y i n p e r s o n , l e a r n e d a d v o c a t e f o r p r i v a t e
respondent and learned AGP.
Perused the impugned order dated 5.12.2013 passed by the  Collector, Mehsana.

That the Central Government has enacted The Food Safety and  Standards Act, 2006 and therefore, the State Government is under process to  e v o l v e t h e p o l i c y w i t h r e g a r d t o d i f f e r e n t a s p e c t s i n c l u d i n g a s p e c t  o f a l l o t m e n t o f t h e f a i r p r i c e s h o p . I n v i e w o f d i r e c t i o n i s s u e d b y
Central Government and State Government
, the Collector has not committed any error in  passing any final order.
However, whenever the Collector, Mehsana proceeds for  finalizing the allotment of the fair price shop
, the petitioner as well as all the  affected persons be heard, and thereafter only appropriate order shall be passed.
7. With the above direction, the present petition is disposed of.
Notice is discharged.s (A.J.DESAI, J.) *Kazi...
